column3: NASB puts a comma between “Baalath-beer” and “Ramah of the Negev.”
“the brook” renders “the wadi”; “before” renders “on the face of.”
“eastward toward the sunrise” renders “eastward, eastward”; “stretches” renders “is turned.”
“Shahazumah” follows the read form of the name; “their border ended at” renders “the extremities of their border were.”
“it ended at the sea” renders “its extremities were toward the sea.”
